title: Intrinsic skill run ledger line
description: One append-only JSONL record per skill engagement. Intrinsic to the skill: not a call to an external calibration service.

discipline_engaged.description: When fired, the discipline or instrument that ran; null when declined.

action_changed.description: Whether the engagement changed the subsequent action.

example.description: When true, the line is a synthetic exemplar and not live telemetry.
